detail.longDescription: A new Study published by researchers at the University of Wisconsin–Madison (UW) and Princeton University, warns that a single Nuclear Detonation at a high enough Altitude could disable virtually every Satellite in low-Earth Orbit # Research # Space https://www. sciencealert.com/a-single-nucl ear-explosion-in-orbit-could-disable-99-of-satellites-in-a-matter-of-days
